1: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength;
2: they shall mount up with wings as eagles;
3: they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
5: Maybe you're running on empty this morning, and the day hasn't even started yet.
6: Eagles don't flap their way up. They spread their wings, and the wind carries them.
7: Waiting on God means you keep working, but you let Him carry the weight.
8: I've worked tired. I've driven home with nothing left. He got me there every time.
9: Let's pray this together. Lord, we're tired this morning, and we're bringing that to You.
10: Renew our strength today. Lift us the way the wind lifts the eagle.
11: Help us run without quitting, and walk without fainting. In Jesus' name, amen.
12: Today, when you start running low, stop right there and ask Him for strength.
13: Send this to somebody who's worn out this morning, and drop an amen below.
14: Carry the Word for today with you. Have a blessed day.
